Complete body in every cell, no text, labels, borders, ground shadow or effects. Generous invisible gutters, retain all hat tips and shoes. Normal proportions remain consistent even when bending, crouching and flying. Row1: (0) same neutral standing reference as first sheet cell1, (1) jab preparation drawing right fist and a tiny gold ring back to chest, (2) hook preparation twisting shoulders left with bent left elbow, (3) kick preparation raising bent right knee toward chest. Row2: (4) heavy arm-sweep preparation arms crossed behind left hip torso wound up, (5) upward strike preparation crouched and looking up with both hands low, (6) low kick preparation standing on left foot with right leg tucked to side, (7) sliding tackle preparation low backward lean with one heel forward and hands behind. Crisp hand painted whole-figure animation drawings, distinct full-body anticipation, no joint pieces, no redesign, no repeated strike pose.
